1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. In you, O Lord , I have taken shelter. Never let me be humiliated. Vindicate me by rescuing me.

2.w: Listen to me. Quickly deliver me. Be my protector and refuge, a stronghold where I can be safe.

3.w: For you are my high ridge and my stronghold; for the sake of your own reputation you lead me and guide me.

4.w: You will free me from the net they hid for me, for you are my place of refuge.

5.w: Into your hand I entrust my life; you will rescue me, O Lord , the faithful God.

6.w: I hate those who serve worthless idols, but I trust in the Lord .

7.w: I will be happy and rejoice in your faithfulness, because you notice my pain and you are aware of how distressed I am.

8.w: You do not deliver me over to the power of the enemy; you enable me to stand in a wide open place.

9.w: Have mercy on me, Lord , for I am in distress! My eyes grow dim from suffering. I have lost my strength.

10.w: For my life nears its end in pain; my years draw to a close as I groan. My strength fails me because of my sin, and my bones become brittle.

11.w: Because of all my enemies, people disdain me; my neighbors are appalled by my suffering — those who know me are horrified by my condition; those who see me in the street run away from me.

12.w: I am forgotten, like a dead man no one thinks about; I am regarded as worthless, like a broken jar.

13.w: For I hear what so many are saying, the terrifying news that comes from every direction. When they plot together against me, they figure out how they can take my life.

14.w: But I trust in you, O Lord ! I declare, “You are my God!”

15.w: You determine my destiny. Rescue me from the power of my enemies and those who chase me.

16.w: Smile on your servant. Deliver me because of your faithfulness.

17.w: O Lord , do not let me be humiliated, for I call out to you. May evil men be humiliated. May they go wailing to the grave.

18.w: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak defiantly against the innocent with arrogance and contempt.

19.w: How great is your favor, which you store up for your loyal followers. In plain sight of everyone you bestow it on those who take shelter in you.

20.w: You hide them with you, where they are safe from the attacks of men; you conceal them in a shelter, where they are safe from slanderous attacks.

21.w: The Lord deserves praise for he demonstrated his amazing faithfulness to me when I was besieged by enemies.

22.w: I jumped to conclusions and said, “I am cut off from your presence!” But you heard my plea for mercy when I cried out to you for help.

23.w: Love the Lord , all you faithful followers of his! The Lord protects those who have integrity, but he pays back in full the one who acts arrogantly.

24.w: Be strong and confident, all you who wait on the Lord .
